hypothesis: An independent global UP/DOWN/SIDEWAYS classifier can suppress counter-regime trades, while a rising fast-versus-slow open-interest oscillator after an EMA20 pullback can identify fresh participation for both trend-aligned longs and shorts.

architecture.layer_1: Direction-only model. Four votes: BTC relative to a rising/falling SMA200, BTC 84-day momentum, six-asset breadth versus SMA100, and median six-asset 28-day momentum. Score >=3 is UP, <=-3 is DOWN, otherwise SIDEWAYS; two consecutive daily labels are required.
architecture.layer_2: Every three days, enter up to two BTC/ETH/SOL positions after a three-day pullback touches EMA20, price reclaims EMA20 in the global direction, the asset remains beyond EMA50 with aligned 28-day momentum, OI EMA7/EMA28 spread is at least +0.05% and rising over three days, and seven-day mean funding is not crowded.
architecture.direction: UP permits longs only; DOWN permits shorts only; SIDEWAYS is mandatory cash.
architecture.oi_interpretation: OI confirms expansion in participation only. It never determines long versus short direction because every open futures contract has both counterparties. Direction comes from price and breadth.

data.source: checksum-verified public Binance USD-M monthly 1d klines/funding and daily 5m metrics archives
data.causality: Only daily candles with close_time strictly earlier than a decision and OI/funding observations timestamped strictly earlier than the decision may be used. Orders rebalance at that decision day's open.

predeclared_robustness.regime_diagnostic: Sample every seven days and report subsequent 20-day BTC return by label.
predeclared_robustness.bootstrap: 5000 deterministic circular 28-day blocks on stress daily returns.

historical_gate.full_stress: Net PnL > 0, Sharpe >= 0.50, max drawdown <= 15%, profit factor proxy from positive/negative daily PnL > 1.05 and positive-month share >= 40%.
historical_gate.directions: Long-regime and short-regime stress PnL must each be non-negative.
historical_gate.time_dispersion: Development and validation stress PnL > 0; retrospective stress PnL >= 0; severe full PnL > 0.
historical_gate.robustness: Both OI-threshold neighbors, both decision phases and at least two of three leave-one-traded-symbol-out replays must be profitable under stress; bootstrap p10 terminal PnL > 0.
historical_gate.promotion: A pass authorizes paper-forward observation only for at least 180 calendar days and 60 decisions. Live trading remains disabled.

disclosures: All history is discovery-contaminated and cannot constitute true out-of-sample evidence.
No post-result parameter adjustment is allowed in S100.
Daily bars cannot represent intraday liquidation, latency, outages, spread spikes or taxes.
